original_prompt: A row of upright wooden dominoes falls in sequence after the first domino is pushed.

initial_condition.description: A visible fingertip is touching the first domino to start the chain.

pre_event_image_prompt: A realistic fixed three-quarter-view photograph of one straight row of upright pale wooden dominoes on a plain tabletop, running from the lower left toward the upper right. A single visible fingertip approaches only the first domino at the left end, just before pushing it. Every domino is upright, individually visible, evenly spaced, and fully inside the frame, with clear room along the entire fall direction. One continuous 1280x704 landscape frame.
text_policy: pre_event_image_prompt is used verbatim for image generation
